english_text: When you go, your steps will not be hampered. When you run, you will not stumble.
english:
Clear purpose smooths the path of daily life.
When you move forward with intention, obstacles become less likely.
Consistent effort keeps you steady and prevents setbacks.
spanish:
Un propósito claro suaviza el camino de la vida cotidiana.
Cuando avanzas con intención, los obstáculos se vuelven menos probables.
El esfuerzo constante te mantiene firme y evita retrocesos.
portuguese:
Um propósito claro suaviza o caminho da vida cotidiana.
Quando avanças com intenção, os obstáculos tornam menos prováveis.
O esforço constante mantém você firme e evita retrocessos.
french:
Un but clair lisse le chemin de la vie quotidienne.
Lorsque vous avancez avec intention, les obstacles deviennent moins probables.
Un effort constant vous garde stable et empêche les revers.
tagalog:
Ang malinaw na layunin ay nagpapakinis ng landas ng pang-araw-araw na buhay.
Kapag ikaw ay sumusulong nang may intensyon, ang mga balakid ay nagiging mas kaunti.
Ang patuloy na pagsisikap ay nagpapanatili sa iyo na matatag at pumipigil sa mga pagkabigo.
swahili:
Kusudi wazi hushughulikia njia ya maisha ya kila siku.
Ukisonga mbele kwa nia, vizingiti huwa wachache.
Juhudi endelevu hukuweka imara na kuzuia kushindwa.
mandarin_chinese:
明确的目标使日常生活的道路更加顺畅。
当你有意向前迈进时，障碍会变得更少。
持续的努力让你保持稳健，防止挫折。
russian:
Чёткая цель делает путь в повседневной жизни более гладким.
Когда вы движетесь вперёд с намерением, препятствия становятся менее вероятными.
Постоянные усилия сохраняют вашу устойчивость и предотвращают неудачи.
malayalam:
വ്യക്തമായ ലക്ഷ്യം ദിനചര്യയുടെ വഴിയെ മിനുക്കുന്നു.
നിങ്ങൾ ഉദ്ദേശത്തോടെ മുന്നേറുമ്പോൾ, തടസ്സങ്ങൾ കുറയുന്നു.
തുടർച്ചയായ ശ്രമം നിങ്ങളെ സ്ഥിരതയോടെ നിലനിർത്തി, വീഴ്ചകൾ തടയുന്നു.
